helices.label: Engineering & Code

deliverables.IDEATE: Technical approach options, architecture diagram, risk flags
deliverables.PLAN: Spec doc, checklist, dependency map, branch name
deliverables.SHIP: Working code, passing types, committed + deployed
deliverables.VALIDATE: Test results, constitutional compliance score, SCRIBE episode

helices.routing_hint: No visual required — route directly to PLAN unless UI is involved

helices.label: UI Design via Stitch

deliverables.IDEATE: Design directions (2-5 options), visual references, design contract draft
deliverables.PLAN: DESIGN_CONTRACT.md locked, Stitch prompt authored, component map
deliverables.SHIP: Stitch-generated HTML exported, JS wired, deployed
deliverables.VALIDATE: Visual QA pass, responsiveness check, Zero Day readiness

helices.routing_hint: Requires DESIGN gate before PLAN — surface visual choices to user first

helices.label: Content Creation

deliverables.IDEATE: Content angle options, audience definition, tone direction
deliverables.PLAN: Outline, word count target, SEO brief, deadline
deliverables.VALIDATE: Readability score, brand voice check, distribution confirmed

helices.routing_hint: Surface categorization: does a user READ this? If yes → this helix

helices.label: Marketing & Campaigns

deliverables.IDEATE: Campaign concept, audience segment, channel mix
deliverables.PLAN: Campaign brief, asset list, timeline, success metrics
deliverables.VALIDATE: Impressions, CTR, conversion vs. targets, retrospective

helices.routing_hint: Often spawns parallel helix-content + helix-stitch tracks — designate lead

helices.label: Photography & Visual

deliverables.IDEATE: Shot list, mood board, location/lighting plan
deliverables.PLAN: Equipment list, call sheet, ingest pipeline setup
deliverables.VALIDATE: Client review complete, archive confirmed, BARNSTORM synced

helices.routing_hint: Field-triggered — often initiated via COMET mobile from gig location

helices.label: Creative Direction

deliverables.IDEATE: 3-5 creative territories with visual language descriptors
deliverables.PLAN: Direction deck, brand rules, asset production brief
deliverables.SHIP: Direction locked, assets seeded, team briefed
deliverables.VALIDATE: Consistency check across surfaces, stakeholder sign-off

helices.routing_hint: Usually spawns child helices — this helix sets direction, others execute

ad_hoc_protocol.description: When INTAKE cannot match an existing helix, create an ad-hoc helix
steps: Draft minimal frame: what does IDEATE/PLAN/SHIP/VALIDATE produce for this task?
Run the task using the temporary frame
VALIDATE: promote to permanent helix if it worked, log deltas if not
